_comment: Prepared queries (plan: Presets). 'criteria', 'channels' and 'touches' are used as the parser/channel fallback and for precomputing cached results. Presets 2-4 have TODO events: pick the real storm/strike on the day.

presets.label: Iron ore mines exposed to the 2026 US midterms
presets.query: Which iron ore mines are exposed to the 2026 US midterms?

channels.reason: A new Congress can change steel and Section 232 tariff policy.
Infrastructure spending drives US steel and iron ore demand.
Federal mining permits depend on the administration and Congress.

presets.touches_note: Hand-set. US = where policy is made; CA = USMCA partner and main pellet trade link; BR = subject of 2025 US tariffs; CN = US-China trade policy; Nippon Steel = owner of U.S. Steel, politically contested. Edit with care and record changes in README.

presets.label: Mines exporting through ports hit by Cyclone Murasu
presets.query: Which iron ore mines export through ports hit by Cyclone Murasu?

channels.reason: Severe Cyclonic Storm Murasu made landfall near Ongole, Andhra Pradesh on 3 Nov 2026; ports on that coast handle iron ore exports.

presets.touches_note: Krishnapatnam is ~100 km south of the Ongole landfall; Visakhapatnam/Gangavaram districts were under IMD flash-flood risk. Weights hand-set.

presets.label: Mines exposed to the BHP Port Hedland wage dispute
presets.query: Which iron ore mines are exposed to the BHP Port Hedland port workers' wage dispute?

event.name: BHP Port Hedland ports wage dispute

channels.reason: The Combined BHP Ports Unions struck at Port Hedland in July and August 2026 and on 15 Sep 2026 said they would seek arbitration after nine months of failed talks; no deal has been reported since.

presets.touches_note: Dispute covers BHP's Port Hedland port operations. Other miners exporting through the same harbour are touched via the port at 0.8. Hand-set. Picked on 8 Nov 2026: no iron ore strike was reported in the past week, and this is the live labour dispute in the sector.
